subject: ZapCloud trial — one-off PO exemption & evidence plan
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@zapcloud.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@zapcloud.ai>
Date: 2027-08-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: ZapCloud pilot — request for one-off PO exemption

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team at ZapCloud is excited to run a short pilot with Redwood (sandbox model routing + dedicated logging) to validate latency and cost for our demo users. The engagement is a 2-week pilot, estimated total spend ~$1,800 (invoice-based).

We generally expect customers to raise a PO, but for quick pilots we usually ask vendors to accept an invoice-only path. Can Redwood provide a one-off PO exemption or an invoice-routing alternative so we can start next week?

We attached a short SOC2/SSO summary for context and can provide W-9 and standard MSA if needed. If there are any procurement forms you need from us to expedite, let me know and I’ll get them over today.

Attachments: ZapCloud-SSO-SOC2-summary.pdf

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Partnerships
ZapCloud
elena.soto@zapcloud.ai
+1 415 555 0192
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@zapcloud.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ZapCloud pilot — request for one-off PO exemption

Thanks Elena — appreciate the quick follow-up and the summary.

A few quick clarifying questions so I can loop in Finance:
- Final estimated pilot spend: is $1,800 the cap, or could usage spike above $5k?
- Can you send a completed W-9 (for US entities) and the corporate billing address?
- We’ll need a signed MSA (we can accept your standard MSA or use Redwood’s). If you have a redline, please include it.

Jonas / Marissa — fyi: ZapCloud is requesting an invoice-only routing for a short pilot (sub-$2k expected). Please advise on current threshold and whether a VP-level one-off approval is sufficient. If Finance needs a formal exception request, I’ll ask ZapCloud to complete the intake form — Elena can you fill in the vendor intake fields? I’ve added a suggested next-step timeline below:

- Today: ZapCloud sends W-9 + MSA (redline if any) + confirm billing contact
- Tomorrow: Finance reviews; Marissa to advise if a one-off approval is sufficient or if we need VP sign-off
- Wed (8/4): If approved, Accounting will provide invoice routing and metadata (PO number or invoice email).

If there’s any preferred language you need from Redwood to include in your internal procurement packet, let me know and I’ll provide it.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, West
Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-08-02T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ZapCloud pilot — request for one-off PO exemption

On Mon, Aug 1, 2027 at 1:42 PM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Elena — appreciate the quick follow-up and the summary.
> 
> A few quick clarifying questions so I can loop in Finance:
> - Final estimated pilot spend: is $1,800 the cap, or could usage spike above $5k?
> - Can you send a completed W-9 (for US entities) and the corporate billing address?
> - We’ll need a signed MSA (we can accept your standard MSA or use Redwood’s). If you have a redline, please include it.

Thanks — copying Elena so she can see the intake checklist. A few notes from Finance / Procurement:

1) Policy: We allow invoice-only (no PO) exceptions for one-off pilots under $5,000, provided the vendor completes the intake form and we have the W-9 and MSA on file. Anything above $5k requires a PO or VP Finance exception with written approval.

2) Evidence we require for an exception: completed vendor intake, W-9, proof of SOC2 or equivalent (summary doc is fine), and invoice metadata (bill-to and remit-to).

3) Timeline: If ZapCloud can provide the items today, I can review and route for approval tomorrow. VP approval turnaround is 24 hrs if the packet is complete.

4) Invoice metadata — please have invoices addressed to:
  Redwood Inference, Inc.
  Attn: Accounts Payable
  1201 Market St, Suite 2100
  San Francisco, CA 94103

I’ve uploaded the one-off approval intake template here: https://docs.internal.redwood.com/procurement/no-po-exceptions-checklist and attached a short excel form you can use (one-off-approval-form.xlsx).

Elena — if you can send the W-9 and a signed MSA, we should be able to process this quickly. If ZapCloud prefers, we can also accept a credit-card prepay for the pilot and avoid the intake; let me know.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: one-off-approval-form.xlsx
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@zapcloud.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ZapCloud pilot — request for one-off PO exemption

On Tue, Aug 2, 2027 at 9:10 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks — copying Elena so she can see the intake checklist. A few notes from Finance / Procurement:
> 
> 1) Policy: We allow invoice-only (no PO) exceptions for one-off pilots under $5,000...

Thanks Karthik and Marissa — this is perfect.

We will:
- Attach W-9 (ZapCloud-W9.pdf) in a follow-up email later today.
- Sign and return the MSA (we’ll use Redwood’s in redline if needed).
- Complete the one-off approval form and include the invoice metadata you listed.

Pilot start target: Aug 8 — happy to prepay by card if that helps speed things up, but we’d prefer invoice routing for accounting. If a VP approval email makes this official, could you route that to me so I can forward it to our procurement team?

I’ll send the W-9 and completed form by EOD. Thanks for the quick turnaround — excited to get started.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Partnerships
ZapCloud
